# Media test fixtures

photo.png is a generated 2×2 solid-color PNG; photo.jpg is its JPEG export. photo.webp is a 1×1 green WebP fixture.

video.mp4 and video.webm are the public MDN flower demonstration clips, used only for validating native uploads/playback. Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/video — files at https://developer.mozilla.org/shared-assets/videos/flower.mp4 and https://developer.mozilla.org/shared-assets/videos/flower.webm. They are sample footage, not civic-issue evidence. The application does not fetch remote media at runtime.
